messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Potential cross-tenant route leak detected in dedicated pool 'dedc-eu-01' (eu-north-1). Automatic alert from prefix-watch. Severity: high. Notifying #incidents and oncall.

tess-oncall: Acknowledged. I'm the oncall lead. Triage started. Which tenants show overlap?

liam-net: Monitoring shows both vpc-orchid and vpc-nimbus advertising 172.20.0.0/16 inside pool dedc-eu-01. Looks like route-manager accepted a duplicate.

vika-eng: Pulling route-manager state now.

```
$ infractl routes list --pool dedc-eu-01 --short
VPC: vpc-orchid prefixes: 172.20.0.0/16
VPC: vpc-nimbus prefixes: 172.20.0.0/16, 172.22.0.0/16
```

harper-plat: There's a recent test rollout that enabled allow-aggregate-duplicates (commit ab12c3f) in route-manager. That could be the cause. Recommend isolating before any rollback to avoid churn.

tess-oncall: Immediate plan: 1) place pool-level deny ACL for vpc-nimbus for 172.20.0.0/16, 2) enable packet capture/mirroring for that prefix to preserve evidence, 3) notify CSM/legal and affected customers. Harper, can you apply ACL? Vika, prep rollback PR.

harper-plat: Applying ACL now.

```
$ infractl acl set --pool dedc-eu-01 --vpc vpc-nimbus --deny 172.20.0.0/16
Result: ACL updated, deny active
```

incident-bot: route-watch: observed withdrawal of 172.20.0.0/16 from vpc-nimbus within ~30s. Route-manager reports duplicate resolved.

vika-eng: Opening rollback PR for commit ab12c3f -> PR #4857. Marking for expedited review. Will include regression tests to prevent re-enable without owner matching.

mike-csm: Notifying customers: OrchidOps and NimbusData. Short note: "We've applied a temporary ACL to prevent potential cross-VPC routing in your dedicated pool. Please pause non-critical traffic and share any anomalous logs." Legal CC'd.

orchid-admin: We've paused nightly backups and are collecting flow logs. Thanks for the heads-up.

nimbus-admin: Investigating our automation. We did not intentionally announce Orchid's prefix. Sending export config and automation logs now.

vika-eng: Quick infra checks: no abnormal object-store access patterns, auth logs normal. Starting 48h flow log collection and preparing audit bundle.

tess-oncall: Handing mitigation watch to Harper. I'll remain available for validation and RCA coordination.

harper-plat: Enabling mirror for 172.20/16 to S3 for legal/audit review.

```
$ infractl mirror create --pool dedc-eu-01 --prefix 172.20.0.0/16 --dest s3://inc-mirrors/dedc-eu-01/1797012345
Mirror created: s3://inc-mirrors/dedc-eu-01/1797012345
```

incident-bot: Pager status: acknowledged by tess-oncall (14:05 UTC). Incident escalated to Platform and SRE.

vika-eng: PR merged and rollback applied. route-manager re-evaluated and no duplicates remain. Pushing diffs and audit notes to ticket INC-2026-0521.

harper-plat: Mirror samples show no inter-VPC L3 forwarding for 172.20/16. Customer flow logs confirm.

mike-csm: Both customers confirm no observable cross-tenant transfers. Legal reviewed a small mirror sample and saw only intra-VPC traffic.

tess-oncall: Next actions: 1) schedule formal RCA, 2) add pre-deploy gate preventing allow-aggregate-duplicates without owner-matching test, 3) add alert rule for prefix observed in >1 VPC on same pool. Owners: vika -> PR/tests, liam -> alerting, harper -> mirror retention and logs. I'll update incident ticket and hand to next oncall.

incident-bot: Pager status changed: resolved by harper-plat (15:22 UTC). Incident state: mitigated; monitoring.

participants: incident-bot, tess-oncall, liam-net, vika-eng, harper-plat, mike-csm, orchid-admin, nimbus-admin
